experiment: Rapture Reproducer V3.1 — Selective Capture and Performance Boundary Closure
manifest_role: Protocol for the selective-capture brief. Extends and does NOT supersede manifests/V3_1-MANIFEST.json (sha256 b94cd5f7...), whose campaigns (detector-only, sampling, targeted recurrence, large-app, privacy) remain valid and are cited as-is. This manifest preregisters ONLY the work that brief requires and the prior campaign did not perform.
frozen_before: any Phase 1 / Phase 2 / Phase 3 measurement under this protocol

inherits_unchanged.privacy_threat_model: V3 gate tier retained; V3 gap tier explicitly NOT solved

gaps_this_manifest_closes: ROUTE_SELECTIVE was never implemented or measured as a performance mode.
ARMED_INCIDENT_WINDOW was never implemented or measured as a performance mode.
Phase 1 fast-path attribution counters were never recorded as an explicit artifact with a zero expectation for unselected traffic.
Correctness under selective capture covered 4 of the 8 frozen V3 incidents (80/80 offline + 80/80 portable); this brief requires all 8 (160/160 + 160/160).
Performance repetitions measured 5000 requests each; this brief requires >= 10000.

implementation_change_disclosure.when: before any measurement under this manifest, after the prior campaign completed
what: select.mjs: added STRATEGY.ROUTE_SELECTIVE and STRATEGY.ARMED_WINDOW, a pre-armed generic rule set parsed from RAPTURE_V31_ROUTES (comma-separated 'METHOD /normalized/path'), and a bounded window governed by RAPTURE_V31_WINDOW_MS / RAPTURE_V31_WINDOW_BUDGET.

state.mjs: added Phase 1 attribution counters (alsStoresCreated, eventBuffersAllocated, boundaryContextHits, boundaryContextMisses), gated behind RAPTURE_V31_ATTRIB=1 so they can never be live during a performance measurement.
implementation_change_disclosure.why_this_is_not_post_hoc_tuning: These modes were required by the protocol and had never been implemented; no existing measurement is altered, and no threshold is moved. The change adds missing capability, it does not tune a measured one.
implementation_change_disclosure.invariant_preserved: The 9 files that determine what a captured request records (events, patch-pg, patch-fetch, patch-time, persist, redact, both oracle files, replay engine) remain BYTE-IDENTICAL to the frozen V3 capture tree. Verified after the change.
implementation_change_disclosure.prior_campaign_validity: Detector-only, sampling, recurrence, large-app and privacy results were produced under impl tree e9232b1f and remain valid for the modes they measured. They are reported at their original values.

phase_1_fast_path_attribution.method: Drive each selection mode with a workload whose requests are all unselected, with RAPTURE_V31_ATTRIB=1, then read the counters.
phase_1_fast_path_attribution.positive_control: The same counters must be NON-zero for selected requests, proving the counters can detect the work they claim is absent.
phase_1_fast_path_attribution.failure_condition: If unselected requests still create capture contexts, allocate event buffers or record boundary events, the sampling architecture does not attack the measured bottleneck and that is reported as such.

phase_2_performance.mode_order: randomized per repetition with a recorded seed

mode_definitions.ROUTE_SELECTIVE_UNMATCHED_ONLY: a route is configured but the measured workload never matches it — the floor case for unmatched traffic
mode_definitions.ROUTE_SELECTIVE_MIXED_10PCT: the configured route receives ~10% of traffic; latency is reported for UNMATCHED requests only, which is the population the deployment gate governs
mode_definitions.ARMED_WINDOW_CLOSED: an incident window was opened and has since closed; measures whether the process returns to the cheap fast path

statistics.point_estimate: median across per-repetition paired MODE-vs-OFF ratios (the estimator frozen by the prior manifest, retained for comparability)
statistics.secondary_estimate: ratio-of-medians reported ALONGSIDE, because independent verification showed the detector-only headline is estimator-sensitive
statistics.rule: both estimators are reported for every gated mode; a gate is called PASS only if it passes under both, otherwise it is reported as ESTIMATOR_DEPENDENT

phase_2_performance.raw_data: every per-repetition file preserved with its full latency array; aggregation never overwrites raw

primary_deployment_gate.population: unselected traffic at SAMPLE_1, SAMPLE_5, SAMPLE_10, and unmatched ROUTE_SELECTIVE traffic

performance_gates.sampling_scaling_gate: SAMPLE_1 and SAMPLE_5 must be materially cheaper than V3_ALWAYS_ON and SAMPLE_10; cost roughly constant in selection rate FAILS the architectural thesis
performance_gates.selected_request_gate: selected requests may pay approximately the V3 capture cost but must preserve correctness

phase_3_correctness.selection: forced into the selected population using ONLY generic selection configuration (RAPTURE_V31_ROUTES); no bug-specific capture logic
phase_3_correctness.offline_conditions: Postgres stopped or unreachable AND fake external dependency stopped; replay must fail closed, never reach live dependencies

phase_4_unsampled_failure_semantics.requirement: trigger a known V3 failure on a request deliberately outside the selected population; the runtime must report NOT_CAPTURED and must not emit an incomplete reproducer
phase_4_unsampled_failure_semantics.reporting: state exactly which failures are capturable per mode; distinguish persistence sampling from execution-interception sampling

phase_5_large_service_probe.status: already executed under the prior manifest (parse-community/parse-server, 45,400 LOC, 0 application source changes)
phase_5_large_service_probe.not_re_run: no eligibility change, no substitution, no re-screening

anti_goalpost_rules: Do not replace a service because its selective-capture performance is bad.
Do not change request count, concurrency or repetition count after seeing results.
Do not count persistence sampling as interception sampling.
Do not claim unsampled failures are captured.
Do not hide run-to-run variance or adverse repetitions.
Report a gate as ESTIMATOR_DEPENDENT rather than choosing the flattering estimator.

decision_rules.CONTINUE: Unselected traffic <=5% median p95 and <=5% throughput with no service >10% p95; overhead clearly scales down with selection rate; all 8 selected V3 incidents preserve exact replay/privacy/fix discrimination; large-service probe supported or bounded.
decision_rules.MODIFY: Selective capture materially reduces overhead and correctness holds, but one deployment/performance/large-service boundary remains clearly identifiable and narrow.
decision_rules.KILL: Meaningful coverage still requires expensive interception on essentially every request; performance does not improve as selection rate falls; exactness/privacy must be weakened; or generic integration needs bug-specific instrumentation.
decision_rules.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Manifest or freeze integrity violated, headline implementation changed after results, corpus selectively replaced, methodology changed post hoc, or correctness measurements untrustworthy.
